book_of_omniscience.name: Ultimate Book of Knowledge
book_of_omniscience.info:
Ultimate Book
(+12 Knowledge)

The Ultimate Book of Knowledge increases your knowledge by 12.

sword_of_power.name: Ultimate Sword of Dominion
sword_of_power.info:
Ultimate Sword
(+12 Attack)

The Ultimate Sword of Dominion increases your attack skill by 12.

protective_cape.name: Ultimate Cloak of Protection
protective_cape.info:
Ultimate Cloak
(+12 Defense)

The Ultimate Cloak of Protection increases your defense skill by 12.

rod_of_magic.name: Ultimate Wand of Magic
rod_of_magic.info:
Ultimate Wand
(+12 Spell Power)

The Ultimate Wand of Magic increases your spell power by 12.

arcane_necklace.name: Arcane Necklace of Magic
arcane_necklace.info:
Arcane Necklace
(+4 Spell Power)

The Arcane Necklace of Magic increases your spell power by 4.
arcane_necklace.pickup_text: After rescuing a sorceress from a cursed tomb, she rewards your heroism with an exquisite jeweled necklace.

magic_bracelet.name: Caster's Bracelet of Magic
magic_bracelet.info:
Caster's Bracelet
(+2 Sepll Power)

The Caster's Bracelet of Magic increases your spell power by 2.
magic_bracelet.pickup_text: While searching through the rubble of a caved in mine, you free a group of trapped dwarves.  Grateful, the leader gives you a golden bracelet.

mage_ring.name: Mage's Ring of Power
mage_ring.info:
Mage's Ring
(+2 Spell Power)

The Mage's Ring of Power increases your spell power by 2.
mage_ring.pickup_text: A cry of pain leads you to a centaur, caught in a trap.  Upon setting the creature free, he hands you a small pouch.  Emptying the contents, you find a dazzling jeweled ring.

witch_broach.name: Witch's Broach of Magic
witch_broach.info:
Witches Broach
(+3 Spell Power)

The Witch's Broach of Magic increases your spell power by 3.
witch_broach.pickup_text: Alongside the remains of a burnt witch lies a beautiful broach, intricately designed.  Approaching the corpse with caution, you add the broach to your inventory.

medal_of_valor.name: Medal of Valor
medal_of_valor.info:
Medal

The Medal of Valor increases your morale.
medal_of_valor.pickup_text: Freeing a virtuous maiden from the clutches of an evil overlord, you are granted a Medal of Valor by the King's herald.

medal_of_courage.name: Medal of Courage
medal_of_courage.info:
Medal

The Medal of Courage increases your morale.
medal_of_courage.pickup_text: After saving a young boy from a vicious pack of wolves, you return him to his father's manor.  The grateful nobleman awards you with a Medal of Courage.

medal_of_honor.name: Medal of Honor
medal_of_honor.info:
Medal

The Medal of Honor increases your morale.
medal_of_honor.pickup_text: After freeing a princess of a neighboring kingdom from the evil clutches of despicable slavers, she awards you with a Medal of Honor.

medal_of_distinction.name: Medal of Distinction
medal_of_distinction.info:
Medal

The Medal of Distinction increases your morale.
medal_of_distinction.pickup_text: Ridding the countryside of the hideous minotaur who made a sport of eating noblemen's knights, you are honored with the Medal of Distinction.

fizbin.name: Fizbin of Misfortune
fizbin.info:
Fizbin

The Fizbin of Misfortune greatly decreases your morale.
fizbin.pickup_text: You stumble upon a medal lying alongside the empty road.  Adding the medal to your inventory, you become aware that you have acquired the undesirable Fizbin of Misfortune, greatly decreasing your army's morale.

thunder_mace.name: Thunder Mace of Dominion
thunder_mace.info:
Thunder Mace
(+1 Attack)

The Thunder Mace of Dominion increases your attack skill by 1.
thunder_mace.pickup_text: During a sudden storm, a bolt of lightning strikes a tree, splitting it.  Inside the tree you find a mysterious mace.

defender_gauntlet.name: Armored Gauntlets of Protection
defender_gauntlet.info:
Armored Gauntlets
(+1 Defense)

The Armored Gauntlets of Protection increase your defense skill by 1.
defender_gauntlet.pickup_text: You encounter the infamous Black Knight!  After a grueling duel ending in a draw, the knight, out of respect, offers you a pair of armored gauntlets.

defender_helmet.name: Defender Helm of Protection
defender_helmet.info:
Defender Helm
(+1 Defense)

The Defender Helm of Protection increases your defense skill by 1.
defender_helmet.pickup_text: A glint of golden light catches your eye.  Upon further investigation, you find a golden helm hidden under a bush.

giant_flail.name: Giant Flail of Dominion
giant_flail.info:
Giant Flail
(+1 Attack)

The Giant Flail of Dominion increases your attack skill by 1.
giant_flail.pickup_text: A clumsy Giant has killed himself with his own flail.  Knowing your superior skill with this weapon, you confidently remove the spectacular flail from the fallen giant.

ballista.name: Ballista of Quickness
ballista.info:
Ballista

The Ballista of Quickness lets your catapult fire twice per combat round.
ballista.pickup_text: Walking through the ruins of an ancient walled city, you find the instrument of the city's destruction, an elaborately crafted ballista.

invisible_shield.name: Stealth Shield of Protection
invisible_shield.info:
Stealth Shield
(+2 Defense)

The Stealth Shield of Protection increases your defense skill by 2.
invisible_shield.pickup_text: A stone statue of a warrior holds a silver shield.  As you remove the shield, the statue crumbles into dust.

dragon_sword.name: Dragon Sword of Dominion
dragon_sword.info:
Dragon Sword
(+3 Attack)

The Dragon Sword of Dominion increases your attack skill by 3.
dragon_sword.pickup_text: As you are walking along a narrow path, a nearby bush suddenly bursts into flames.  Before your eyes the flames become the image of a beautiful woman.  She holds out a magnificent sword to you.

axe_of_power.name: Power Axe of Dominion
axe_of_power.info:
Power Axe
(+2 Attack)

The Power Axe of Dominion increases your attack skill by 2.
axe_of_power.pickup_text: You see a silver axe embedded deeply in the ground.  After several unsuccessful attempts by your army to remove the axe, you tightly grip the handle of the axe and effortlessly pull it free.

divine_armor.name: Divine Breastplate of Protection
divine_armor.info:
Divine Breastplate
(+3 Defense)

The Divine Breastplate of Protection increases your defense skill by 3.
divine_armor.pickup_text: A gang of rogues is sifting through the possessions of dead warriors.  Scaring off the scavengers, you note the rogues had overlooked a beautiful breastplate.

minor_scroll.name: Minor Scroll of Knowledge
minor_scroll.info:
Minor Scroll
(+2 Knowledge)

The Minor Scroll of Knowledge increases your knowledge by 2.
minor_scroll.pickup_text: Before you appears a levitating glass case with a scroll, perched upon a bed of crimson velvet.  At your touch, the lid opens and the scroll floats into your awaiting hands.

major_scroll.name: Major Scroll of Knowledge
major_scroll.info:
Major Scroll
(+3 Knowledge)

The Major Scroll of Knowledge increases your knowledge by 3.
major_scroll.pickup_text: Visiting a local wiseman, you explain the intent of your journey.  He reaches into a sack and withdraws a yellowed scroll and hands it to you.

mighty_scroll.name: Superior Scroll of Knowledge
mighty_scroll.info:
Superior Scroll
(+4 Knowledge)

The Superior Scroll of Knowledge increases your knowledge by 4.
mighty_scroll.pickup_text: You come across the remains of an ancient Druid.  Bones, yellowed with age, peer from the ragged folds of her robe.  Searching the robe, you discover a scroll hidden in the folds.

superior_scroll.name: Foremost Scroll of Knowledge
superior_scroll.info:
Foremost Scroll
(+5 Knowledge)

The Foremost Scroll of Knowledge increases your knowledge by 5.
superior_scroll.pickup_text: Mangled bones, yellowed with age, peer from the ragged folds of a dead Druid's robe.  Searching the robe, you discover a scroll hidden within.

bottomless_sack.name: Endless Sack of Gold
bottomless_sack.info:
Endless Sack

The Endless Sack of Gold provides you with 1000 gold per day.
bottomless_sack.pickup_text: A little leprechaun dances gleefully around a magic sack.  Seeing you approach, he stops in mid-stride.  The little man screams and stamps his foot ferociously, vanishing into thin air.  Remembering the old leprechaun saying 'Finders Keepers', you grab the sack and leave.

bottomless_bag.name: Endless Bag of Gold
bottomless_bag.info:
Endless Bag

The Endless Bag of Gold provides you with 750 gold per day.
bottomless_bag.pickup_text: A noblewoman, separated from her traveling companions, asks for your help.  After escorting her home, she rewards you with a bag filled with gold.

bottomless_purse.name: Endless Purse of Gold
bottomless_purse.info:
Endless Purse

The Endless Purse of Gold provides you with 500 gold per day.
bottomless_purse.pickup_text: In your travels, you find a leather purse filled with gold that once belonged to a great warrior king who had the ability to transform any inanimate object into gold.

nomad_boots.name: Nomad Boots of Mobility
nomad_boots.info:
Nomad Boots

The Nomad Boots of Mobility increase your movement on land.
nomad_boots.pickup_text: A nomad trader seeks protection from a tribe of goblins.  For your assistance, he gives you a finely crafted pair of boots made from the softest leather.  Looking closely, you see fascinating ancient carvings engraved on the leather.

traveler_boots.name: Traveler's Boots of Mobility
traveler_boots.info:
Traveler's Boots

The Traveler's Boots of Mobility increase your movement on land.
traveler_boots.pickup_text: Discovering a pair of beautifully beaded boots made from the finest and softest leather, you thank the anonymous donor and add the boots to your inventory.

rabbit_foot.name: Lucky Rabbit's Foot
rabbit_foot.info:
Rabbit's Foot

The Lucky Rabbit's Foot increases your luck in combat.
rabbit_foot.pickup_text: A traveling merchant offers you a rabbit's foot, made of gleaming silver fur, for safe passage.  The merchant explains the charm will increase your luck in combat.

golden_horseshoe.name: Golden Horseshoe
golden_horseshoe.info:
Horseshoe

The Golden Horseshoe increases your luck in combat.
golden_horseshoe.pickup_text: An ensnared unicorn whinnies in fright.  Murmuring soothing words, you set her free.  Snorting and stamping her front hoof once, she gallops off.  Looking down you see a golden horseshoe.

lucky_coin.name: Gambler's Lucky Coin
lucky_coin.info:
Coin

The Gambler's Lucky Coin increases your luck in combat.
lucky_coin.pickup_text: You have captured a mischievous imp who has been terrorizing the region.  In exchange for his release, he rewards you with a magical coin.

four_leaf_clover.name: Four-Leaf Clover
four_leaf_clover.info:
Clover

The Four-Leaf Clover increases your luck in combat.
four_leaf_clover.pickup_text: In the middle of a patch of dead and dry vegetation, to your surprise you find a healthy green four-leaf clover.

travelers_compass.name: True Compass of Mobility
travelers_compass.info:
Compass

The True Compass of Mobility increases your movement on land and sea.
travelers_compass.pickup_text: An old man claiming to be an inventor asks you to try his latest invention.  He then hands you a compass.

sailors_astrolabe.name: Sailor's Astrolabe of Mobility
sailors_astrolabe.info:
Astrolabe

The Sailors' Astrolabe of Mobility increases your movement on sea.
sailors_astrolabe.pickup_text: An old sea captain is being tortured by ogres.  You save him, and in return he rewards you with a wondrous instrument to measure the distance of a star.

spell_book.name: Magic Book
spell_book.info:
Magic Book

The Magic Book enables you to cast spells.
